# mimecast_emergency_contact (Data Source)

Read the typed Cloud Gateway emergency-contact configuration. Mutation is excluded because the API has no safe delete or reset lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_emergency_contact" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_code` (String, Sensitive) Mimecast account code.
- `alternate_email_addresses` (List of String, Sensitive) Alternate emergency email addresses.
- `contact_email_address` (String, Sensitive) Emergency contact email address.
- `contact_name` (String, Sensitive) Emergency contact name.
- `id` (String) Stable data source ID.
- `mobile_phone` (String, Sensitive) Emergency mobile number.
- `telephone` (String, Sensitive) Emergency telephone number.
